rule: A price is a founder value. Each entry here is a dated founder act naming one amount; src/config/pricing.ts must cite a matching entry (amount_inr equal to the config value) or the build fails - scripts/pricing-gate.mjs and the page itself both check. An empty list means NO price exists and no INR figure may appear on any non-frozen route. The seven content-frozen routes are governed by their own seal (CONTENT-FREEZE.json), including the landing's 'intended' tier copy. Entries are appended, never edited: a price change is a new act, and the old act stays on the record.
